measurement.scope: synchronous complete predict; all compared models resident; load and warmup excluded
measurement.system_power: SMC PSTR only, without a component-sum floor; includes baseline machine power; not a calibrated external meter
measurement.integration: trapezoidal, monotonic receive timestamps; interpolated interval boundaries
measurement.component_integration: diagnostic estimates only: IOReport reports preceding-interval averages, so treating them as point samples can shift boundaries by about half a sample
measurement.idle_subtraction: mean of preceding and following settled idle; negative values retained
measurement.counter_caveat: Direct PSTR-only sampling; component counters are not read or emitted, and no component-sum floor is applied.
measurement.telemetry_sanity: All samples must be positive, finite and below the configured system-power ceiling; any failure invalidates the energy run without deleting or clipping samples.
measurement.ratio_identity: speed * average power reduction = energy per decision improvement (do not multiply speed again)

compression.operator_selection: conv only; threshold >2048; norms/RoPE/attention left unchanged
